info.title: EDA Notification System API
info.description:
Event-driven notification service: accepts SMS, Email and Push notifications, stores them
and delivers them asynchronously through priority queues (high > normal > low), with a
per-channel rate limit of 100 messages/second, automatic retries with exponential backoff,
and real-time status tracking.

**Conventions**
- All notifications are processed asynchronously: create endpoints answer `202 Accepted`
  and the delivery status can be followed with `GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}`.
- Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on create requests to make client retries safe.
- Every response carries an `X-Correlation-ID` header (send your own to trace a flow).
- Errors share one envelope: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {...}}}`.

**Notification lifecycle**

`pending → queued → processing → sent`; temporary provider failures go back to `queued`
with `next_retry_at`; permanent failures (or exhausted attempts) end in `failed`.
`scheduled`, `pending` and `queued` notifications can be cancelled.

get.description:
Filter by status, channel, priority, batch and creation date range. Uses cursor
pagination: follow `links.next` / `meta.next_cursor` to page through results.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

next_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the next set of items.

prev_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the previous set of items.

post.description:
The notification is stored and queued for asynchronous delivery (202 Accepted).
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: repeating the request with
the same key and payload returns the original notification (200,
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of creating a duplicate.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the same key + payload returns the original result instead of creating duplicates. 1-200 printable ASCII characters.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Optional trace id, echoed back and attached to every log line of this request and its delivery.

200.description: Idempotent replay (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`): the notification created earlier with this key.

422.description: Validation failed, or `idempotency_key_reused`: the key was used with a different payload.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

202.description: Accepted: stored and queued for delivery. Body is the notification resource.

get.summary: Get a notification with its delivery attempts

patch.description:
Only notifications that are not yet being delivered (scheduled, pending, queued)
can be cancelled; otherwise 409 is returned. Cancelling twice is a no-op.

409.description: The notification is already being delivered or reached a final state (`invalid_status_transition`).

post.description:
Re-queues a notification in `failed` status with a fresh attempt budget (202).
Any other status returns 409.

409.description: Only notifications in `failed` status can be retried (`invalid_status_transition`).

post.description:
Accepts up to 1000 notifications. The batch is stored atomically (all or nothing)
and every notification gets the same `batch_id`. Supports `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the same key + payload returns the original result instead of creating duplicates. 1-200 printable ASCII characters.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: Optional trace id, echoed back and attached to every log line of this request and its delivery.

200.description: Idempotent replay (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`): the batch created earlier with this key.

422.description: Validation failed (more than 1000 items, or any invalid item: nothing is stored), or `idempotency_key_reused`.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

202.description: Accepted: the whole batch was stored atomically and queued.

get.description: Returns how many notifications of the batch are in each status.

patch.description: Cancels every notification of the batch that has not started delivery yet.

post.description: Re-queues every `failed` notification of the batch with a fresh attempt budget.
post.summary: Retry failed notifications of a batch

503.description: Database or Redis unreachable: the service cannot accept notifications (`status: down`).

get.description:
Queue depth per priority, notifications per status, success/failure rates, throughput
and latency (p50/p95/p99) over a time window, circuit breaker state and active workers.
`?window=1m|5m|15m|1h|24h` (default 5m). `?format=prometheus` returns the Prometheus
text format.

Status.description: Notification lifecycle: scheduled ──► pending ──► queued ──► processing ──► sent       │            │           │            │       │            │           │            ├──► queued   (retryable failure, backoff)       │            │           │            └──► failed   (permanent failure / attempts exhausted)       └────────────┴───────────┴──► cancelled    queued ──► failed  (job gave up on unexpected errors)   failed ──► queued  (manual retry)
